record.one_liner: Aircall offers a REST API and Webhooks supporting OAuth 2.0 and Basic Auth for managing phone calls, contacts, users, campaigns, and analytics.
record.blocker: Public integrations require becoming an approved tech partner and requesting OAuth credentials.

auth_methods.quote: With Aircall Public API, Authentication can be done through OAuth or Basic Auth.

access_test.quote: Before starting building the OAuth flow for your app, you will need to get OAuth client_id and client_secret from Aircall.

access_ship.quote: You’re building a public integration and are an approved tech partner

api_type.quote: Aircall Public API is a classic REST API.

api_breadth.quote: This service allows any developers to retrieve and manage Aircall data with HTTP requests.
